name: Lifeprotocol
fix_description: In handleRatio, ratio calculation uses manipulable on-chain balance. Fix: use time-weighted values.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-flash-loan exploit with a simple repeated buy-then-sell pattern against one vulnerable protocol contract. It requires minimal protocol-specific understanding beyond noticing broken pricing/accounting in the buy/sell logic, and a competent auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
